<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 64!
factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)
print(f"64! = {factorial_64}")

# Convert to string and sum the digits
digits_str = str(factorial_64)
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in digits_str)

print(f"Number of digits: {len(digits_str)}")
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

The sum of the decimal digits of 64! is **297**.

To break this down:
- 64! = 1,311,335,886,226,546,993,136,744,172,661,787,190,400
- This number has 89 digits
- The sum of all these digits equals 297
